neighbours.label: shell variables and command arguments in command-line text, such as $USER, $HOME and sudo
fire: To stop it, run killall -u $USER -TERM nginx in a terminal.
The script copies the file to $HOME/.config before starting.
Then type ./configure && make && sudo make install to finish.
Use chown $USER:$USER on the folder if writing fails.
Add export PATH=$PATH:$HOME/bin to your shell profile.
Run sudo systemctl restart docker after editing the file.
Check the exit code with echo $? after the command.
Log in again with su - $USER to pick up the new group.
quiet: To stop it, close the nginx window from the task manager.
The installer copies the file to your settings folder before starting.
Then follow the installer's steps to finish the setup.
Change the folder's owner in the file browser if writing fails.
Add the bin folder to your search path in the settings app.
Restart the docker service from the system tray after editing the file.
Check whether the program reported an error in its log.
Log out and back in to pick up the new group.

notes: Probe: 'as $USER' peaked on USER at 0.33; 'localhost' in a URL read 0.03. Low confidence.
